final: WITH pairs AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS mean_rate FROM pairs), ex AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_rate, p.avg_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess FROM pairs p, m WHERE p.avg_rate > m.mean_rate), r AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink) AS rank_in_scope FROM ex) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate, excess, rank_in_scope FROM r WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope
